answer_1.quote: Personalized text generation aims to provide textual content tailored to user preferences and needs, involving tasks ranging from information seeking to user simulation.
answer_1.outputs: textual content tailored to user preferences and needs

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation of personalized text generation can be conducted using reference-based and reference-free approaches.

answer_3.quote: In reference-free evaluation, an LLM can assess the generated content directly, assigning scores based on various aspects, including how well the content aligns with the user profile or preferences, offering a more dynamic and personalized evaluation framework.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is also an effective validation method for determining whether an agent has successfully completed a personalized task.
answer_4.guideline: assess the quality and relevance of the generated content
